title: Extra Crispy Monster Bait
description: Extra Crispy Monster Bait — The Townstons wiki
html:
Extra Crispy Monster Bait
Skill Type:  Passive
Trainer:  Ranger
Number of Ranks:  1
Cost to Max:  Unknown
Increase the health of your Monster Bait by 100%

Extra Crispy Monster Bait is a Passive skill that increases the health of Monster Bait, and thus the amount of damage the bait can take before being destroyed. This skill is useful to any build that uses Monster Bait to draw enemy attacks away from the player. In order to take effect, Extra Crispy Monster Bait needs to be placed in the hot bar along with Monster Bait.


This skill currently only has one level, so it can not be upgraded from skill trainers. Skill books for Extra Crispy Monster Bait will say that they upgrade the skill to level 2/1, but using them will not upgrade the skill in any way. Below is the description as it appears in the game.


Place this in your skill tray to upgrade your Monster Bait skill. The skill increases the health of your Monster Bait by 100%
